urlText: Ferries will be busy during Vivid Sydney
content:
Ferry passengers are advised to expect delays and long queues for ferries to and from the city during Vivid Sydney from Friday 23 May to Saturday 14 June.
  • Services will be busy and are expected to reach capacity from mid-afternoon, particularly on weekends.
  • Some additional F3 and F4 ferries will run on weeknights and weekends during the event.
  • Vivid Sydney attendees planning to catch a ferry to precincts around Circular Quay, Barangaroo or Pyrmont should plan ahead and have a back-up transport option in mind, from most wharves you can catch buses to the city or to nearby train stations to connect with services to the city.
  • Visit the Vivid Sydney event page for more details on transport services during the event.

urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
content:

  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.

Because of road conditions at Gloucester unsuitable for coaches, passengers booked to travel on 136 from Belbora and Gloucester will travel on a minibus to Krambach. Passengers on coach 135 travelling to Belbora and Gloucester will change from 135 at Krambach to a minibus to Belbora and Gloucester.  
 
The coach stop at Krambach will be temporarily moved to the Krambach School of Arts, 3758 The Bucketts Way, Krambach. No other coach stop locations on these routes have changed.
 
These changes will be in place up to and including Friday the 30th of May, 2025.

urlText: L2 and L3 partial line closures during Vivid Sydney on Fridays and weekends
content:
During Vivid Sydney from Friday 23 May to Saturday 14 June, L2 Randwick Line and L3 Kingsford Line light rail services will be partially closed on Friday nights and weekends.
  • L2 and L3 light rail services will not run between Town Hall and Circular Quay due to road closures and for pedestrian safety on the following days and times:
    • Fridays from 6pm to 1am
    • Weekends from 5pm to 1am (Saturdays, Sundays and public holiday Mon 9 Jun)

  • Light rail services will continue to run between Town Hall and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford during these times. L1 Dulwich Hill Line light rail services will run as per normal during Vivid Sydney from 5am to 1am daily.
  • If you’re travelling to Circular Quay, continue on foot from Town Hall or change for trains.
  • Note on Saturdays and on Sunday 8 June from 6pm to 11pm, Sydney Trains services will not drop off passengers at Circular Quay Station – use Wynyard, Martin Place or St James stations instead.
  • Allow extra travel time as services will be very busy. Visit the Vivid Sydney event page for more details on transport services during the event.
